entries.instruction: Grab the lightweight round tabletop trashbin and pour balls.
Pick up the smooth plastic tabletrashbin and pour it.
Pick up the tabletrashbin for holding small trash and pour it.
Pick up the desktop tabletrashbin for small trash and pour it.
Pour the small bin for table waste into the big bin.
Grab the lightweight round tabletop trashbin and pour into big bin
Pick up the plastic tiny trashbin for tables and pour it.
Lift the plastic tiny trashbin for tables and empty it.
Lift the lightweight round tabletop trashbin and empty it.
Grab the compact tabletop trashbin and pour balls.
Pick up the small bin for table waste, pour balls into the bin.
Lift the small smooth gray trashbin and transfer the contents.
Grab the lightweight round tabletop trashbin and pour the balls.
Lift the small smooth gray trashbin and empty it.
Lift the smooth plastic tabletrashbin and transfer the contents.
Lift the rectangular plastic bin and transfer the contents.
Grab the plastic tiny trashbin for tables and pour into big bin
Grab the lightweight round tabletop trashbin and pour the balls.
Take the rectangular light gray trash bin and empty it.
Lift the tabletrashbin for tabletop use and transfer the contents.
